run_decision_transformer_experiment: run the decision transformer experiment with pretraining and online finetuning on a d4rl environment
create_experiment_instance: create an Experiment instance with a variant dict to initialize the decision transformer model and replay buffer
pretrain_decision_transformer: pretrain the decision transformer model on offline trajectories using the pretrain method with a loss function
online_finetune_model: finetune the pretrained decision transformer model with online rollouts and trajectory augmentation
evaluate_model_performance: evaluate the decision transformer model on vectorized evaluation environments and return metrics
